consequence.statement: The `--registry` flag is no longer honored; packages without fully qualified registry host names will not resolve and must be updated before the upgrade completes.

assertion.statement: The `--registry` CLI flag for specifying a default package registry has been removed; all packages must now use fully qualified names including the registry host name.
